I want to write a test for RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder.Configure that exercises the code path where the connection string is obtained from IConfiguration.GetConnectionString. This requires setting up a mock ISiloBuilder, a mock IConfigurationSection with no ServiceKey but with a ConnectionName and no ConnectionString, and a mock IServiceProvider that returns a mock IConfiguration which returns a test connection string for GetConnectionString.

I will first check the signature of ISiloBuilder.AddRedisGrainDirectory to understand how to mock it. I will look for the definition of AddRedisGrainDirectory in the repository. It is likely an extension method on ISiloBuilder. I will look in the src/Redis directory for extension methods on ISiloBuilder.

I will list the src/Redis directory to find relevant files.

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Hosting;
using Orleans.GrainDirectory.Redis;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Redis.Tests
{
    public class RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilderTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void Configure_UsesGetConnectionStringFromIConfiguration_WhenConnectionNameProvidedAndConnectionStringEmpty()
        {
            // Arrange
            var builderMock = new Mock<ISiloBuilder>();
            var optionsBuilder = new OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>(new ServiceCollection());
            Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>> configureAction = null!;

            builderMock
                .Setup(b => b.AddRedisGrainDirectory(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>()))
                .Callback<string, Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>((name, action) =>
                {
                    configureAction = action;
                })
                .Returns(builderMock.Object);

            var configSectionMock = new Mock<IConfigurationSection>();
            configSectionMock.SetupGet(c => c["ServiceKey"]).Returns(string.Empty);
            configSectionMock.SetupGet(c => c["ConnectionName"]).Returns("MyConnectionName");
            configSectionMock.SetupGet(c => c["ConnectionString"]).Returns(string.Empty);

            var configurationMock = new Mock<IConfiguration>();
            configurationMock.Setup(c => c.GetConnectionString("MyConnectionName")).Returns("TestConnectionString");

            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock
                .Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(IConfiguration)))
                .Returns(configurationMock.Object);

            // Act
            var builder = new RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder();
            builder.Configure(builderMock.Object, "TestName", configSectionMock.Object);

            // Now invoke the captured configureAction to simulate the options configuration
            configureAction(optionsBuilder);

            // The optionsBuilder.Configure<IServiceProvider> callback is internal, so we simulate calling it:
            var options = new RedisGrainDirectoryOptions();
            var configureServicesDelegate = optionsBuilder.Services.BuildServiceProvider().GetService<IServiceProvider>();
            // Instead of invoking the internal Configure<IServiceProvider> delegate, we invoke the delegate directly from optionsBuilder
            // We can get the delegate by reflection or by re-invoking the Configure method on optionsBuilder
            // For simplicity, we will invoke the delegate by calling Configure<IServiceProvider> again with our mock service provider

            // We need to get the internal configure delegate from optionsBuilder
            // Instead, we simulate the call by invoking the delegate passed to Configure<IServiceProvider>
            // We do this by creating a new OptionsBuilder and calling Configure<IServiceProvider> with our mock service provider

            // We simulate the call by invoking the delegate directly:
            var configureMethod = typeof(OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>).GetMethod("Configure", new[] { typeof(Action<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, IServiceProvider>) });
            Assert.NotNull(configureMethod);

            // We invoke the Configure method with a delegate that captures the inner configure delegate
            RedisGrainDirectoryOptions capturedOptions = null!;
            IServiceProvider capturedServices = null!;
            optionsBuilder = new OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>(new ServiceCollection());
            builder.Configure(builderMock.Object, "TestName", configSectionMock.Object);
            configureAction(optionsBuilder);

            // Now get the internal configure delegate by reflection
            var configureField = typeof(OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>).GetField("_configureActions", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            Assert.NotNull(configureField);
            var configureActions = configureField.GetValue(optionsBuilder) as System.Collections.Generic.List<Delegate>;
            Assert.NotNull(configureActions);
            Assert.NotEmpty(configureActions);

            // The last configure action is the one we want to invoke
            var lastConfigure = configureActions[^1];
            lastConfigure.DynamicInvoke(options, serviceProviderMock.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(options.ConfigurationOptions);
            Assert.Equal("TestConnectionString", options.ConfigurationOptions.ToString());
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Hosting;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Redis.Tests
{
    public class RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilderTests
    {
        private class TestOptionsBuilder<TOptions> : OptionsBuilder<TOptions> where TOptions : class, new()
        {
            public Action<TOptions, IServiceProvider>? ConfigureAction { get; private set; }

            public TestOptionsBuilder(IServiceCollection services) : base(services)
            {
            }

            public override OptionsBuilder<TOptions> Configure<TDep>(Action<TOptions, TDep> configureOptions)
            {
                ConfigureAction = (options, sp) => configureOptions(options, sp.GetRequiredService<TDep>());
                return this;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Configure_UsesGetConnectionStringFromIConfiguration_WhenConnectionNameProvidedAndConnectionStringEmpty()
        {
            // Arrange
            var builderMock = new Mock<ISiloBuilder>();
            TestOptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>? capturedOptionsBuilder = null;

            builderMock
                .Setup(b => b.AddRedisGrainDirectory(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>()))
                .Callback<string, Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>((name, action) =>
                {
                    var services = new ServiceCollection();
                    var optionsBuilder = new TestOptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>(services);
                    action(optionsBuilder);
                    capturedOptionsBuilder = optionsBuilder;
                })
                .Returns(builderMock.Object);

            var configSectionMock = new Mock<IConfigurationSection>();
            configSectionMock.SetupGet(c => c["ServiceKey"]).Returns(string.Empty);
            configSectionMock.SetupGet(c => c["ConnectionName"]).Returns("MyConnectionName");
            configSectionMock.SetupGet(c => c["ConnectionString"]).Returns(string.Empty);

            var configurationMock = new Mock<IConfiguration>();
            configurationMock.Setup(c => c.GetConnectionString("MyConnectionName")).Returns("TestConnectionString");

            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock
                .Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(IConfiguration)))
                .Returns(configurationMock.Object);

            // Act
            var builder = new RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder();
            builder.Configure(builderMock.Object, "TestName", configSectionMock.Object);

            // Simulate the options configuration delegate invocation
            var options = new RedisGrainDirectoryOptions();
            Assert.NotNull(capturedOptionsBuilder);
            Assert.NotNull(capturedOptionsBuilder.ConfigureAction);
            capturedOptionsBuilder.ConfigureAction(options, serviceProviderMock.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(options.ConfigurationOptions);
            Assert.Equal("TestConnectionString", options.ConfigurationOptions.ToString());
        }
    }
}
